_comment: Evaluation-only external-listener pool: Claude Opus 5 at medium effort. This is the pool configs/eval_suite.json points at, and the only guesser evaluation ever uses -- every other pool in this directory is for training (see docs/iteration-architecture.md's 'two roles for guessers'). Opus 5 runs adaptive thinking by default; 'effort': 'medium' is what keeps the cost down, rather than disabling thinking, which on Opus 5 can leak <thinking> tags into the visible response (see codenames/guessers/llm.py::LLMGuesser.__init__). Effort is part of the response-cache key (LLMGuesser.cache_model_id), so changing it here will not silently reuse rankings produced at a different effort -- but it WILL change EvalSuite.suite_id, which invalidates every already-paid-for game in the eval store. Settle it before spending money, not after. Shares cache/llm_store.db with the Haiku/Sonnet entries; keyed by model, so no collision.
